scope: Independent review of the repository and both existing releases. Repeated claims share an entry; all inventoried files have a disposition in claim-inventory.json. A verified claim is conditional on the listed surviving evidence, not a guarantee of universal truth.
prior_audits: Examined as historical assertions, never used as a successful-verification premise.

claims.claim: The project combines full-weight Gaussian ES with correctness-gated response novelty; it is an adaptation, not a replication.
claims.method: Read full central papers and pinned code; compare equations and call path.
claims.correction: Clarify paper versus released helper defaults and different checkpoint selection.

claims.claim: Population standard deviation and stabilizer define Z(Q); a flat quality vector contributes exactly zero.
claims.method: Equation/source comparison, analytic tests, independent NumPy coefficients.
claims.correction: None to historical optimization.

claims.claim: Novelty is added after quality normalization; no later ranking or centering; alpha absorbs inverse sigma.
claims.method: Read equation and applied coefficient vectors from every committed generation.
claims.correction: Retain old rank registration as superseded historical text.

claims.claim: Only exactly correct history/siblings enter nearest-neighbor novelty; self excluded, empty pool max zero, frozen scoring precedes seeded FIFO insertion.
claims.method: Direct implementation and analytic-vector tests; compare upstream call path.
claims.correction: Do not claim every historical cosine was independently recomputed; full embedding/archive trajectory is absent.

claims.claim: Fresh FP32-master reconstruction avoids repeated BF16 add/subtract restoration drift; name-hashed streams differ from upstream correlated layers.
claims.method: Read numerical paths and Appendix A.1; direct tensor tests.
claims.correction: Numerical rationale, not evidence of performance superiority; initial masters were converted from BF16-loaded weights.

claims.claim: Each arm began from exactly the original pretrained tensors.
claims.method: Inspect retained files and history; distinguish final tensors from missing generation-zero tensors.
claims.correction: State that records describe this initialization but equality cannot now be independently re-established.

claims.claim: Architecture, unique tensor count and parameter elements of released models.
claims.method: Read exported config and safetensors headers; compare every exported tensor with checkpoint master cast.
claims.correction: Generate from exports, not historical initialization flags; stored unique elements, not memory or activations.

claims.claim: Complete response strings are embedded.
claims.method: Read pinned tokenizer cap and tokenize existing training-probe strings only.
claims.correction: Complete strings are supplied but the encoder caps WordPiece inputs including special tokens. No logged probe exceeded that cap; no embedding inference performed.

claims.claim: Verifier accepts arithmetic using each supplied integer once.
claims.method: Independent precedence parser plus syntax constraints; regrade all saved response events and evaluations.
claims.correction: Describe restricted Python syntax, optional single answer tag, ignored surrounding prose, and rejected unary/power/floor-division/unparenthesized newlines.

claims.claim: Synthetic problems are sampled uniformly.
claims.method: Inspect proposal sampling and target/witness rejection.
claims.correction: Only operand proposals are uniform; accepted witnessed problems form a rejection-biased distribution.

claims.claim: Witnesses solve the problems and number multisets/identities do not overlap across splits.
claims.method: Independent rational witness grading, hash/count verification, global multiset and ID check.
claims.correction: Do not equate internal split separation with exclusion of pretrained-data contamination.

claims.claim: Training uses matched rotating training prompts and fixed training probes, with validation/test excluded from updates.
claims.method: Reconstruct prompt/noise schedules and check raw training response membership/order/offsets and candidate seeds.
claims.correction: Label probes as training data, not generalization evidence.

claims.claim: Greedy accuracy, validity, reward, counts and bootstrap intervals.
claims.method: Independent grading/counts and NumPy paired percentile bootstrap; compare every displayed summary field.
claims.correction: Keep pilot original-test and continuation fresh primary labels explicit.

claims.claim: Sampled pass@1/pass@8 and within-problem diversity.
claims.method: Exact combinatorial estimator from raw complete sampled groups and independently graded canonical structures.
claims.correction: Always label original-test sampled subset, including continuation; distinguish from fresh greedy accuracy.

claims.claim: The pass@k estimator is unbiased.
claims.method: Read estimator derivation in full paper; exact combinatorial tests.
claims.correction: Conditional subset probability is exact; model-draw unbiasedness requires independent draws. Do not infer a zero probability from finite samples.

claims.claim: Complete sampled groups require valid unique sample indices.
claims.method: Regression cases with duplicated and out-of-range indices in partial groups.
claims.correction: Reject invalid partial groups too; independent verifier also rejects missing, extra, reordered or duplicate evaluation identities.

claims.claim: No demonstrated novelty advantage in either primary comparison.
claims.method: Recompute main-minus-control point estimates and paired intervals from raw matched problems.
claims.correction: Pilot narrative now states that its interval includes zero; do not assert equivalence or a systematic negative effect.

claims.claim: Positive novelty sometimes changes applied update weights.
claims.method: Independent float32 coefficient comparison on recorded candidate populations; zero control coefficient.
claims.correction: Local coefficient intervention only; not a replay of an alternative trajectory or proof of causation for final differences.

claims.claim: Canonical expression-tree diversity measures useful reasoning diversity.
claims.method: Inspect canonicalization (sort addition/multiplication children only) and independently reconstruct structures.
claims.correction: Treat as a narrow structural diagnostic; not complete algebraic equivalence or verified semantic reasoning diversity.

claims.claim: Training and evaluation token totals measure resources.
claims.method: Sum saved token IDs and response events separately; reconcile committed generation and stored evaluation totals.
claims.correction: Distinguish cumulative from additional training; stored from newly generated evaluation; reused baseline and separate parent evaluations; retries remain in event totals.

claims.claim: Reported training hours are compute time.
claims.method: Inspect wall-clock intervals and restart provenance.
claims.correction: These are recorded phase wall intervals including overhead, excluding offline time and unknown unlogged outage tail; not GPU compute-hours.

claims.claim: Output examples represent the compared checkpoints on matched problems.
claims.method: Compare fixed first-problem rows, identities, text and grades with raw evaluations.
claims.correction: State fixed-order selection; tag correct/legal-wrong/invalid; no cherry-picked success showcase.

claims.claim: Axes start at zero and scales are shared across compared conditions.
claims.method: Inspect plotting/DOM code, rendered figures and PDFs; controls tested separately.
claims.correction: Retain panel-specific upper scales and explicit percentage units; browser disposition recorded separately.

claims.claim: One report command preserves the combined experiment history.
claims.method: Generate continuation then pilot and assert both aggregate entries remain.
claims.correction: Use per-study summary registry; report-all stages both releases together.

claims.claim: Continuation commands can resume the existing experiment.
claims.method: Inspect expired deadlines, source versus recovery paths and download plans.
claims.correction: Current instructions restore, verify and report completed artifacts; historical launch commands clearly marked. Include separately published model exports.

claims.claim: Independent verification and staged reporting do not mutate source evidence.
claims.method: Hash input evidence before/after, reject overlapping output paths, test staged byte preservation.
claims.correction: Explicitly exclude live dashboard bookkeeping/cache from stable-evidence inventory; no model execution imports in verifier.

claims.claim: Registration, weighting amendment, continuation and recovery core were published before their dependent executions.
claims.method: Compare GitHub server merge times with raw persisted run/phase clocks and inspect commit contents.
claims.correction: Amendment followed calibration and partial baseline evaluation; local event clocks are not independently attested hardware timestamps.

claims.claim: The interrupted continuation expired; recovery is a separately registered allowance.
claims.method: Check copied source hashes, deadlines, run clocks and server history.
claims.correction: Never describe the recovered result as satisfying the earlier missed deadline.

claims.claim: Every numerical recovery field was preserved exactly at initialization.
claims.method: Inspect retained parent versus active checkpoint state; initial active control checkpoint no longer exists.
claims.correction: Historical audit reports exact initialization; current check establishes source-copy hashes and unchanged main weights, not unavailable initial control tensors.

claims.claim: Observed interrupted response replay matches saved text, tokens and grades.
claims.method: Compare raw failed-write prefix and repeated training responses, excluding timing.
claims.correction: Not arbitrary-hardware or full-trajectory equivalence; historical audit flags not used as premises.

claims.claim: Both arms improve over parent checkpoints on the same fresh set; difference in changes is secondary.
claims.method: Recompute paired changes and four-outcome difference-in-differences; no model inference.
claims.correction: Descriptive unadjusted secondary intervals; one seed, pilot-motivated continuation.

claims.claim: Problem bootstrap excludes training-seed variability and can degenerate at boundaries.
claims.method: Inspect resampling unit and exact constant-vector examples.
claims.correction: No equivalence or population-zero claims from zero-width intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted secondary claims.

claims.claim: Multi-seed, diagnostic controls and TinyStories scratch work are planned.
claims.method: Distinguish specifications/hypotheses from completed artifact inventory.
claims.correction: No new training, resumed training, inference or experimental runs authorized by this audit.

claims.claim: ExTra adaptation uses Apache-2.0; ES at Scale Academic Public License allows the stated noncommercial scope with redistribution conditions.
claims.method: Read full licenses and pinned implementation; inspect retained notices and modification record.
claims.correction: Do not imply APL code can be relabeled Apache or that a commercial restriction prohibits all research reuse.

claims.claim: EVOL-RL uses semantic novelty and a transductive setting.
claims.method: Read method/evaluation definitions and embedding setup.
claims.correction: It reports transductive adaptation AND held-out transfer; replace vague heavier scorer with named embedding model. Its empirical scores were not reproduced.

claims.claim: DARLING combines quality/diversity with semantic partitions and studies lexical reward failure.
claims.method: Read method and lexical ablation; inspect MIT terms.
claims.correction: Motivation for a diagnostic, not evidence that this project's novelty succeeds.

claims.claim: MoDA uses mode-conditioned RL, quality-gated nearest-neighbor diversity and Apache-2.0 code.
claims.method: Read quality gate and nearest-neighbor definition; inspect license.
claims.correction: No performance claim transferred to this study.

claims.claim: AC/DC coevolves task/model archives using merging, SVD mutation and dominated novelty.
claims.method: Read mechanism sections and SVD/DNS appendices.
claims.correction: No official code reuse or reproduction claimed.

claims.claim: Reward-only full-weight ES can be studied for solution coverage without explicit novelty reward.
claims.method: Read study setup and stated coverage objective.
claims.correction: Its findings motivate a control; they do not predict this experiment's result.

claims.claim: Conti and novelty-based Decision Transformers concern behavioral ES/control rather than LLM language training.
claims.method: Check primary abstracts and MIT source license; no source copied.
claims.correction: Decision Transformer repository license remains unverified; no reuse asserted.

claims.claim: Artifact/prompt evolution and archive-to-finetuning are distinct from this project's full-weight ES.
claims.method: Read primary method summaries and QDAIF finetuning appendix; inspect OpenELM MIT license.
claims.correction: Do not imply archive finetuning guarantees improvement.

locations: docs/literature.md DivPO, DQO, VPO, CDE, OCNR
claims.claim: Nearby methods respectively select diverse preference pairs, use determinantal group reward, vector/set reward, curiosity bonuses and self-play task novelty.
claims.method: Check primary abstracts/method overviews against narrow classifications.
claims.correction: No code reuse or empirical reproduction; OCNR entry remains abstract-level.

claims.claim: NoveltyBench evaluates distinct useful outputs; EGGROLL structures individual perturbations at low rank; MeZO is memory-efficient zeroth-order tuning.
claims.method: Check primary abstracts and algorithm descriptions; no performance figures repeated.
claims.correction: Low-rank perturbations are not a statement that the entire aggregate update is a LoRA adapter.

claims.claim: Held-out data, bounded claims and uncertainty disclosure follow cited research-practice guidance.
claims.method: Check primary guidance; distinguish normative commitments from achieved guarantees.
claims.correction: No claim that a checklist proves scientific validity.

claims.claim: The documented Python/uv/local pipeline and dependencies are reproducible.
claims.method: Run locked environment tests and real read-only CLI report/verify paths; inspect package entry points.
claims.correction: Python series and dependency versions are constrained; no cross-hardware bitwise guarantee or claim to newest packages. GPU is needed for historical model execution, not this read-only audit.

claims.claim: Atomic checkpoints, RNGs, pending candidates, logging and absolute deadlines support recovery.
claims.method: Inspect save/restore paths and fault/replay tests; compare surviving raw evidence.
claims.correction: Log flush is not power-loss durability; discarded unused permissive final-line parser. Replay evidence is scoped to observed environment.

claims.claim: Dashboard is loopback-bound, read-only and route-allowlisted.
claims.method: Inspect HTTP routes, bind address, textContent usage and local service tests.
claims.correction: No blanket guarantee for manually corrupted JSON or all deployment environments.

claims.claim: Published dashboard controls, examples and labels work visually.
claims.method: Static source/state checks plus observed controls and screenshots in the public HTTPS dashboard; deployment-specific checks are recorded separately.
claims.correction: The detached Chrome interface was recovered by selecting the existing public HTTPS tab. The UI record identifies the exact deployment inspected; static checks alone are not a visual pass.

claims.claim: Earlier audits passed checks at their recorded dates.
claims.method: Inspect assertions and available original inputs; recheck supported underlying claims separately.
claims.correction: Preserve old files/receipts, annotate overview text, route current independent work to new verifier.

claims.claim: Both releases and research collection exist at immutable revisions; current corrections leave weights unchanged.
claims.method: Read Hub/GitHub server revisions and file hashes; upload only allowlisted documentation paths and compare remaining file metadata.
claims.correction: Original receipts stay immutable; new dated receipt links predecessor and correction revisions.

claims.claim: Paper author is Libor Burny Burian; AI assistance statement describes requested authorship/provenance.
claims.method: Check generated author/date and required statement against supplied specification.
claims.correction: Keep AI statement in papers only; human cleanup status is the requested statement, not independently observed work.

claims.claim: Every inventoried claim has a disposition; no assertion of an error-free universe.
claims.method: Map all inventoried surfaces to reviewed claim groups; preserve unresolved and historical dispositions.
claims.correction: Reachability is not evidentiary support; missing historical records and deployment-specific inspection scope remain explicit.

claims.claim: Model-execution, phase boundaries, overall deadlines and publication transfers have distinct timing scopes.
claims.method: Compare persisted phase clocks with server-side original Hub commit times; read the frozen transfer exception.
claims.correction: Disclose the small calibration completion overrun and later pilot evidence transfer; publication transfer may finish later under the registration. Never reset an expired deadline.
